# obot Provider

Connects to Obot using an API-scoped key. Set `OBOT_BASE_URL` and obtain `OBOT_TOKEN` with `export OBOT_TOKEN="$(obot login --scope api --print-token)"`. Explicit provider configuration takes precedence over environment variables. See the [catalog and access-policy guide](guides/catalogs-and-access-policies.md) for managing catalog sources and the Everything policy, and the [tunnel guide](guides/mcp-tunnels.md) for tunnel credentials and import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    obot = {
      source  = "obot-platform/obot"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Reads OBOT_BASE_URL and OBOT_TOKEN when base_url and token are not set.
provider "obot" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Obot app URL or API base URL. Falls back to `OBOT_BASE_URL`. A trailing `/api` is added when omitted.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Obot API key with API access. Falls back to `OBOT_TOKEN`. Obtain it with `obot login --scope api --print-token`.
